motifs.name: material advantage or hanging enemy piece
motifs.description: The side to move is at least a pawn ahead in material, or material is level while an enemy minor piece or better hangs to a free or favorable capture.

motifs.name: consolidated queenless material lead or dual margin-trump parity edge
motifs.description: Not in check, with no unit hanging or attacked by a cheaper piece, a calm own king ring and no advanced enemy passer, the side to move is either a clean point or more up in a fully queenless position (a single-pawn edge requiring one comparative trump) or at exact material parity holding two or more margin trumps among passers, pawn health, rook activity, bishop pair, outposts, space, development and king quality.

motifs.name: concrete target with safe camp at material parity or better
motifs.description: Not behind in material, not in check, and with none of its own pieces profitably capturable, the side to move owns a concrete target: a static-exchange-winning capture, a besieged weak enemy pawn, exclusive heavy-piece infiltration, a safe advanced passer, a trapped ventured enemy minor, or a dominant attack on the enemy king ring.

motifs.name: positional edge at level material
motifs.description: With no material advantage, the side to move holds a clear positional plus from safe piece mobility, pressure on the enemy king zone, passed pawns, open rook files, king shelter and the bishop pair, while none of its own pieces are loose.

motifs.name: space, development and initiative dominance near material parity
motifs.description: With material within a fraction of a pawn, the side to move holds a broad concrete edge combining space, central control, development lead, pressure on enemy pieces, king safety, passed pawns and rook placement.

motifs.name: pawn health and piece activity superiority at equal material
motifs.description: Material is exactly equal but the side to move has clearly healthier pawns, better passed pawns, more active rooks and outposts, a safer king and more pressure on the enemy king zone.

motifs.name: calm parity squeeze against a structurally burdened opponent
motifs.description: At exact material parity, with none of its pieces hanging or attacked by lesser men and its own king ring calm, the side to move holds a durable plus such as an exclusive open-file heavy battery, an advanced protected pawn duo, a rim-stranded enemy knight, a blocked-pawn-buried enemy bishop, shut-in enemy rooks against its own free rook, or a far healthier pawn structure.

motifs.name: sole bishop pair at exact material equality
motifs.description: With material exactly level, not in check, none of its pieces hanging and its king zone not swarmed, the side to move owns two bishops on opposite color complexes while the opponent lacks the bishop pair.

motifs.name: dynamic compensation without material edge
motifs.description: With material equal or slightly down and its own pieces basically safe, the side to move has concrete compensation such as a safe fork or double attack, a favorably capturable or pinned enemy piece, an advanced supported passer, a manned assault on an exposed enemy king, a development lead against a stranded central king, or a broad activity and structure edge.

motifs.name: parity bind: bad enemy bishop, pawn clamp, or queenless outside majority
motifs.description: At exact material parity with a calm camp, no development lag and no advanced enemy passer, the side to move either faces a hemmed-in bad enemy bishop while owning a good minor, or clamps space with three secure pawns beyond the middle against none, or in a queenless position holds a clean pawn majority on a wing far from the enemy king.

motifs.name: entrenched minor-piece outpost at level material or clean check refutation
motifs.description: With material exactly level, a safe camp and king, the side to move has a knight or bishop on an advanced pawn-proof supported outpost that the opponent cannot match, or it is in check but can capture the lone checker without loss and stand one to three points ahead.

motifs.name: parity shelter or file grip on enemy king, or queenless grind edge
motifs.description: At exact material parity with a safe camp, the side to move either keeps a clearly healthier king shelter than the enemy with queens on, or aims a heavy piece down a file near the enemy king that holds no defending pawns while its own shelter is better, or in a queenless position holds a clear combined edge in passers, king activity, rook activity and pawn health.

motifs.name: temporary material deficit repaid with interest by winning capture
motifs.description: The side to move is a pawn or more behind on raw material, yet owns a legal capture whose static exchange gain exceeds the deficit (or exactly repays it while a second exchange-winning target hangs), and the opponent has no bigger counter-capture elsewhere.

motifs.name: mid-exchange full recapture restoring the balance with an edge
motifs.description: Temporarily down material mid-exchange, the side to move has a capture whose static-exchange value fully repays the deficit to roughly level, after which the opponent has no profitable capture and the mover keeps the better structure, king pressure, passers, rook files or bishops.

motifs.name: cornered intruder roundup or minor-army imbalance
motifs.description: Not ahead in raw material and not in check, the side to move either besieges an enemy piece stranded deep in its camp with no safe retreat so it can be rounded up for a net gain, or at level count owns two extra minor pieces against rook-and-pawn style compensation or a full piece against three pawns.

motifs.name: wing king behind fully open file assaulted at exact parity
motifs.description: At exact material parity, not in check, with its queen on and no friendly unit profitably capturable, the side to move keeps own pawns ahead of its king on every adjacent file while the enemy king sits on a wing back rank behind at least one adjacent file holding no enemy pawn in front of it, and strictly more mover pieces or a thorn pawn bear on the enemy king field than enemy pieces bear on the movers king.

motifs.name: asymmetric shelter breach attack at exact material parity
motifs.description: With material exactly level, queens on for the mover, both kings on their back two ranks and none of its pieces loose, the side to move keeps a fully intact pawn shelter while the enemy wing king is missing a near shelter pawn on at least one adjacent file and faces at least as many, and at least two, of the movers pieces bearing on its king zone.

motifs.name: stranded enemy king with queens on or refutable check
motifs.description: Near material parity the side to move faces an enemy king stranded on its back rank without castling rights or wandered up the board while queens stay on and its own king is sheltered, or it can win a trapped enemy queen, or it stands materially fine after a check whose giver hangs to a favorable capture.

motifs.name: queen-led siege of a castling-less central enemy king
motifs.description: At material parity or down at most one pawn, the side to move keeps its queen and a secure king while the enemy king is stuck on the d, e or f file near its home rank with no castling rights, backed by an adjacent half-open file, king-ring pressure or a development lead.

motifs.name: wrecked enemy king shelter with attacker surplus near parity
motifs.description: Near material parity with its queen still on board and its own king ring not swarmed, the side to move besieges an enemy king whose pawn shelter is destroyed or clearly inferior, holding strictly more distinct attackers on the enemy king ring than the opponent has on its own.

metadata.score_definition: P(motif=True | winning) - P(motif=True | losing), measured on the discovery training dataset.
